name: ModelScope API-Inference
amount: 1,000 requests per day per model, free
summary: Alibaba's model community serves many open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and more) through a free, OpenAI-compatible API. ModelScope describes it as a non-commercial, non-profit service for developers to try models. Requires an Alibaba Cloud account binding and real-name verification.
source_note: ModelScope API-Inference limits page, checked 2026-09-28. Not tracked per model: we can't pass real-name verification.
